text:
Maya: quick sync — we need a short owner list for the api header changes before EOD. who is taking migration owner for billing and mobile SDK?
Zack: I can take billing. Can we confirm the exact header keys being removed?
Priya: removing X-Redwood-Client and X-Redwood-Alias (deprecated). New header is Redwood-Client-Info. doc: https://go.redwood/docs/api-headers
Alex: I put a short PR up to update the node SDK: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pull/432 — needs review for the header mapper
Maya: thanks. Alex can you tag the PR with migration:billing and migration:mobile so we can track?
Alex: done. added labels. also left a note in the PR about fallback behavior — default to old header for 7 days after rollout.
Priya: FYI deployment plan: canary in us-west for 2 hours, then 10% global for 24h, then full. fallback route to v1 on error 429/5xx.
Zack: billing owner questions — does legacy header still get logged to analytics? we should avoid double-counting.
Maya: good catch. analytics-team: we'll emit a single canonical client id field server-side and strip duplicates in the pipeline.
Alex: CI flake: one test failing in mapping spec. quick patch incoming.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: staging -> canary at 2026-03-18T15:30Z (job #8842). status: queued.
Priya: owners: Billing = Zack, Mobile SDK = Alex, Docs & GUIDES = Maya. Can we get a final ack from each?
Zack: ack. will review SDK changes and the billing ingest for duplicates.
Alex: ack. will push the flake fix in 10min and then request a canary deploy.
Maya: ack. I'll update the migration checklist and ping support with a short blurb.
Priya: one more: node SDK minor bump must be published to npm before global rollout. Alex, can you coordinate the release window?
Alex: yes. aiming to publish at +30m after canary passes. I will post the npm tag here when done.
Maya: perfect. if anything blocks, @here call me out. otherwise we'll treat this as the canonical owner list. :thumbsup:
Zack: quick note — I'll add a tiny integration test that asserts analytics emits single client id. PR after canary.
Priya: deploy-bot: canary started. 1777777805 - watch logs at https://go.redwood/logs/8842
Alex: npm tag published: v2-compat-20260318
Maya: closing loop — I'll open a follow-up thread for post-rollout verification metrics. thanks everyone.
